section.title: Course Description and Goal
section.p: MATH 123 Introduction to Functions (Gen. Ed. satisfying Core Math or Domain II-A requirements)

An exploration of numerical, graphical, and symbolic approaches to function concepts with emphasis on real-world applications, modeling, and problem-solving skills. Topics include polynomial and rational functions, equations and inequalities, systems of linear equations, and the connection between functions and their graphs. This course includes an additional a one-hour per week lecture recitation. Topics may vary by section at the discretion of the instructor with the goal of supporting students' readiness for, and success, in the lecture course.
